items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And Reven is my wife’s son, and he’s white.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they got pretty good. And like the two that were really pulled were Al and Reven, the one that liked rock & roll, and Al who liked R&B. They auditioned for the same blues band when they were older and they both got on the band. It was amazing. And they traveled. And my kids are interracial kids, you know, and they were traveling with this black singer in the south. And Reven is my wife’s son, and he’s white. And Al looks like he’s from, I don’t know, Al looks like either Spanish or Arab, you know he…
Well this was — what year are you talking about now?
